description: This file implements webhook handling and server monitoring for the BlueBubbles integration, including request parsing, rate limiting, target registration, and server info fetching.

methods.name: clearBlueBubblesWebhookSecurityStateForTest
methods.description: Clears rate limiter states for testing purposes.

methods.name: registerBlueBubblesWebhookTarget
methods.description: Registers a webhook target with the server route and returns an unregister function.

methods.name: parseBlueBubblesWebhookPayload
methods.description: Parses incoming webhook payload, handling JSON and URL-encoded formats.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if applicable.

methods.name: maskSecret
methods.description: Masks a secret string for logging.

methods.name: normalizeAuthToken
methods.description: Normalizes an auth token string, removing 'Bearer' prefix.

methods.name: collectTrustedProxies
methods.description: Collects trusted proxy addresses from webhook targets.

methods.name: resolveWebhookAllowRealIpFallback
methods.description: Determines if real IP fallback is allowed based on targets.

methods.name: resolveWebhookClientIp
methods.description: Resolves the client IP address considering proxies and fallback options.

methods.name: handleBlueBubblesWebhookRequest
methods.description: Main handler for incoming webhook requests, including rate limiting, auth, payload parsing, and event processing.

methods.name: monitorBlueBubblesProvider
methods.description: Sets up the webhook server, fetches server info, and manages lifecycle.
